# `Browser.Microphone.Internals`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Microphone.Internals — the low-level microphone capture port
surface: the closed outbound/inbound ADTs and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js`
request/subscribe wiring the high-level `Ipe.Browser.Microphone` layer wraps.

Importing this submodule discloses the same `js-port:microphone` axis as the
top-level module (the disclosure is keyed on the `Ipe.Browser.Microphone` path
prefix), so the raw port surface cannot be reached undisclosed.

## `JsCmd`

The ONE closed OUTBOUND port type. `CaptureAudio opts` starts a bounded
audio recording: the host calls `getUserMedia({ audio: true })`, starts a
`MediaRecorder`, collects chunks for `maxDurationMs` milliseconds, assembles
them into a single Blob, and replies ONCE with the base-64 data URL.

The `maxDurationMs` value is capped at 8 000 ms on the JS side (comfortably
within the `Js.request` per-waiter deadline of 10 s, leaving room for Blob
assembly and the data-URL read). A caller that supplies a larger value gets
a 8 s recording — the cap is documented, not silent.

## `JsMsg`

The NARROW closed INBOUND port type — NOT the app's internal `Msg`. Every
variant the browser can push is enumerated, so the fold in the high-level
layer is EXHAUSTIVE and a denial or an absent API can never be silently
dropped: it becomes a typed `Err`.

  * `Recorded data mime durationMs` — the recording completed; `data` is the
    base-64-encoded `data:` URL of the assembled audio Blob, `mime` is the
    actual MIME type the browser used (e.g. `audio/webm`), and `durationMs`
    is the clamped recording duration in milliseconds.
  * `Denied` — the host refused the microphone permission.
  * `Unavailable` — `getUserMedia` or `MediaRecorder` is absent in this context.

## `request`

```ipe
request : JsCmd -> Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`request cmd` — hand a closed outbound `JsCmd` to the raw port transport.
The served first-party JS sink starts the recording; the reply arrives
inbound as a `JsMsg`.

## `requestOne`

```ipe
requestOne : JsCmd -> Task Error JsMsg
```

`requestOne cmd` — correlated one-shot `JsCmd` → `Task Error JsMsg`.
Routes through `Js.request` with the `inbound` decoder so the correlated
reply is decoded fail-closed by the same gate the `subscribe` path uses.

## `subscribe`

```ipe
subscribe : (JsMsg -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`subscribe toMsg` — the inbound subscription over the fail-closed seal
decoder. `inbound` IS the security gate; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole.

## `inbound`

```ipe
inbound : Decode.Decoder JsMsg
```

The total, fail-closed decoder for a `JsMsg` frame of this capability.

It first requires the frame's `tag` to be `portTag`, so a frame of another
capability, or an untagged one, fails closed; the rest decodes as `inboundBody`.
